<!-- =========================================================
                     PROD -- production. Separate domain AND separate infrastructure, not a
                     rename of staging, and it does not share the DEV/STAGE Client ID.
                     Student-only pilot since 04 SEP 2026.
                     ========================================================= -->

sections.label: Stage · Staging server
sections.preamble:
<!-- =========================================================
                     STAGE -- staging server, and the bulk of the catalogue. Staff portals,
                     then the course-level Skills, then the E010 and D522 skill-level
                     links in course order.
                     ========================================================= -->

sections.label: Dev · Development server
sections.preamble:
<!-- =========================================================
                     DEV -- development server, currently unusable. All four links
                     reach WGU SSO correctly, then the LTI service answers "Tool
                     not found". Measured 10 SEP 2026, the DEV hosts are also down:
                     wgu-dev-api accepts a TCP connection and never responds on 443
                     or 80, and wgu-dev serves a certificate for another name. Two
                     separate faults, escalated.
                     ========================================================= -->
